verse.verse_1: Have We not lifted up your heart,
verse.verse_3: that weighed so heavily on your back, and
verse.verse_4: have We not given you high renown?
verse.verse_5: So, surely with every hardship there is ease;
verse.verse_6: surely, with every hardship there is ease.
verse.verse_7: So, when you are free, strive hard,
verse.verse_8: and to your Lord turn [all] your attention.
